This is the main gallery of data visualizations which have been created
using the R package [animint2](https://github.com/animint/animint2).
The goal of this gallery is to demonstrate the different kinds of data visualizations that can be created.
There are other galleries:

* Similar general scope gallery of data visualizations, but in French: [La galerie en français pour animint2](https://animint.github.io/gallery-fr)
* [animint2 machine learning gallery](https://tdhock.github.io/gallery-ml): visualizations of classic and state-of-the-art algorithms.
* [animint2 optimization gallery](https://tdhock.github.io/gallery-opt): visualizations of classic optimization algorithms, for teaching.
* [Change-point detection gallery](https://tdhock.github.io/gallery-change-point): visualizations of classic and state-of-the-art change-point detection algorithms.
* [HiC gallery](https://tdhock.github.io/gallery-hic) and [Gallery of results visualization for hicream article](https://eoojj.github.io/hicream-article-viz/): visualizations of HiC genomic data, to support our [hicream Bioinformatics 2026 paper](https://academic.oup.com/bioinformatics/advance-article/doi/10.1093/bioinformatics/btag631/8770358?login=true).


```{r Ropts, echo=FALSE}
options(width=200)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo=FALSE,
  results="asis")
ahref <- function(href, text){
  sprintf('<a href="%s">%s</a>', href, text)
}
suppressWarnings(suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(data.table)))
```

```{r}
myread <- function(csv, repo.col){
  if(!file.exists(csv))return(data.table())
  nc::capture_first_df(
    data.table::fread(csv),
    viz_owner_repo=list(owner=".*?", "/", repo_only=".*")
  )[
  , img.png := sprintf("repos/%s.png", viz_owner_repo)
  ][
  , viz.link := ahref(
      sprintf("https://%s.github.io/%s/", owner, repo_only),
      ifelse(
        file.exists(img.png),
        sprintf('<img src="%s" alt="%s" />', img.png, viz_owner_repo),
        viz_owner_repo))
  ][
  , repo.link := ahref(
    sprintf("https://github.com/%s/tree/gh-pages", viz_owner_repo),
    "repo")
  ][]
}
repos_dt <- fread("repos.txt",col.names="viz_owner_repo",header=FALSE)
meta.dt <- myread("meta.csv")[, let(
  source.link = ahref(source, "source"),
  video.link = ifelse(video=="", "", ahref(video,  "video"))
)][
, links := paste(repo.link, source.link, video.link)
][
  repos_dt, on="viz_owner_repo", nomatch=0L
  ##order(-add.POSIXct)
]
error.dt <- myread("error.csv", "viz_owner_repo")
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(meta.dt[, .(
  viz.link, title, links
)])
download <- function(csv){
  cat(ahref(csv, paste("Download this table: ", csv)))
}
download("meta.csv")
```

```{r}
if(nrow(error.dt)){
  cat("## Visualizations with missing meta-data\n")
  download("error.csv")
  knitr::kable(error.dt[, .(
    viz.link, repo.link, error
  )])
}
```
